title: Making Site Launches Repeatable
summary: A structured checklist turned launch knowledge into a consistent team process.
principles: Reliable outcomes should not depend on which experienced person happens to perform the work.
looking_back: The checklist is valuable because it can keep evolving as new failure modes appear. A launch process should be a maintained operational control, not a static document.
body: Site launches varied by person, and important steps were sometimes missed.
People had different experience levels and habits, with no shared launch standard.
I created a structured checklist covering the steps required for a reliable and complete launch.
Launches became more consistent across the team, reducing avoidable post-launch issues.

perspectives.name: Julie
perspectives.text: The goal was not to make everyone launch exactly like me. It was to make the required outcome independent of memory.

perspectives.name: Min
perspectives.text: A checklist is a control against predictable human variation.

perspectives.name: Harbor
perspectives.text: It preserves experience without requiring the experienced person to be present.
